description: Test whether the GLIPR1L2 N-terminal extension is evolutionarily conserved by measuring the offset from Met1 to the pan-CAP HNxxR anchor motif across mammalian orthologs, compared with GLIPR1
code:
import requests, re, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
q=("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene:GLIPR1L2+AND+taxonomy_id:40674"
   "&fields=accession,organism_name,length,sequence&format=json&size=200")
js=requests.get(q,timeout=90,headers=H).json()
orths={}
for e in js["results"]:
    org=e["organism"]["scientificName"]; L=e["sequence"]["length"]
    if org not in orths or L>orths[org][0]: orths[org]=(L,e["sequence"]["value"],e["primaryAccession"])
full={o:v for o,v in orths.items() if v[0]>=280}

HUM=orths["Homo sapiens"][1] if "Homo sapiens" in orths else None
L2=""
GL1="MRVTLATIAWMVSFVSNYSHTANILPDIENEDFIKDCVRIHNKFRSEVKPTASDMLYMTWDPALAQIAKAWASNCQFSHNTRLKPPHKLHPNFTSLGENIWTGSVPIFSVSSAITNWYDEIQDYDFKTRICKKVCGHYTQVVWADSYKVGCAVQFCPKVSGFDALSNGAHFICNYGPGGNYPTWPYKRGATCSACPNNDKCLDNLCVNRQRDQVKRYYSVVYPGWPIYPRNRYTSLFLIVNSVILILSVIITILVQHKYPNLVLLD"

# anchor on the pan-CAP "HNxxR" motif that opens the CAP domain
pat=re.compile(r"HN[EDKQNA][LMVIFWY]R")
def anchor(s):
    m=pat.search(s[:130]); return m.start()+1 if m else None
print("CAP 'HNxxR' anchor offsets (distance from Met1 to the start of the motif):")
print(f"  human GLIPR1L2 : {anchor(L2)}   (motif {L2[anchor(L2)-1:anchor(L2)+4]})")
print(f"  human GLIPR1   : {anchor(GL1)}   (motif {GL1[anchor(GL1)-1:anchor(GL1)+4]})")
print(f"  -> GLIPR1L2 carries {anchor(L2)-anchor(GL1)} extra residues N-terminal to the CAP domain vs GLIPR1\n")

offs=[]
for o,(L,s,acc) in full.items():
    a=anchor(s)
    if a: offs.append((o,acc,L,a,s[:a+4]))
d=pd.DataFrame(offs,columns=["organism","acc","len","anchor_offset","nterm"])
print(f"Anchor found in {len(d)}/{len(full)} near-full-length orthologs.")
print(f"  median offset = {d.anchor_offset.median():.0f}  (IQR {d.anchor_offset.quantile(.25):.0f}-{d.anchor_offset.quantile(.75):.0f}), human = {anchor(L2)}")
print(f"  orthologs whose offset is >= GLIPR1-like 44 + 10 = 54 (i.e. carrying an N-terminal extension): "
      f"{(d.anchor_offset>=54).sum()}/{len(d)} ({100*(d.anchor_offset>=54).mean():.0f}%)")
print(f"  GLIPR1 human offset for reference = {anchor(GL1)}")

# conserved motif within the extension itself (human residues 1-16 MEAARPFAREWRAQSL)
ext_pat=re.compile(r"^M[EKDRQ][AVTSGP]")
print(f"\n  orthologs beginning with the human-like M-[EKDRQ]-[AVTSGP] extension motif: "
      f"{sum(1 for _,(L,s,a) in full.items() if ext_pat.match(s))}/{len(full)}")
print("  examples of the conserved extension (first 18 aa):")
for o in ["Homo sapiens","Pan troglodytes","Gorilla gorilla gorilla","Callithrix jacchus",
          "Ailuropoda melanoleuca","Balaenoptera musculus","Camelus ferus","Mus musculus","Sus scrofa"]:
    if o in full: print(f"    {o:26s} {full[o][1][:18]}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4))
ax[0].hist(d.anchor_offset,bins=np.arange(25,95,3),color="#2b6cb0",edgecolor="w")
ax[0].axvline(anchor(L2),color="#e53e3e",lw=2,label=f"human GLIPR1L2 ({anchor(L2)})")
ax[0].axvline(anchor(GL1),color="#38a169",lw=2,ls="--",label=f"human GLIPR1 ({anchor(GL1)})")
ax[0].set_xlabel("residues from Met1 to the CAP 'HNxxR' anchor")
ax[0].set_ylabel("number of mammalian orthologs")
ax[0].set_title("The N-terminal extension of GLIPR1L2 is conserved,\nnot a human annotation artefact",fontsize=10)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)

lab=["N-term\next. 1-22","cryptic SP\n23-42","mature\nN-term 43-57","CAP domain\n58-192","TM helix\n254-274","juxta-\nmem. 275-291","acidic tail\n292-344"]
val=[46.9,56.8,89.7,97.1,94.2,62.9,75.6]
cols=["#fc8181","#f6ad55","#68d391","#a0aec0","#e53e3e","#cbd5e0","#d6bcfa"]
ax[1].bar(range(7),val,color=cols,edgecolor="w")
ax[1].axhline(70,color="#4a5568",ls=":",lw=1.2); ax[1].text(5.2,72,"pLDDT 70",fontsize=7.5)
ax[1].set_xticks(range(7)); ax[1].set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=7.2)
ax[1].set_ylabel("mean pLDDT"); ax[1].set_ylim(0,105)
ax[1].set_title("AlphaFold confidence: the TM helix is well modelled (94.2),\nthe N-terminal extension is not (46.9)",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
